LESSON: PHONIC DEVELOPMENT

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.2: Phonic development

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Phonic development. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build
   In simple words: practise until you can read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Phonic development using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Phonic development in the examples.
2. Explain Phonic development to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Phonic development.
4. Show that you can: read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonic development using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Phonic development important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learners match letter cards to sounds
2. Learners practice letter-sound matching(letter sound make words? a) develop knowledge of recognition) 4 lessons letter-sound recognition
3. Learners build letters into syllables b) build phonemes into
4. Learners match diagraphs to words that contain syllables them (ng,ny, ng, dh,th) c) read and sound syllables
5. Learners blend and segment sounds to build d) relate syllables to their syllables into words sounds 136 e) appreciate the use of

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read and sound syllables  Learners blend and segment sounds to build

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
